issuer: Jeevan Raksha Life Assurance Co., Policyholder Servicing Division
summary: Your annual life insurance premium of Rs. 24,500 is due. You have a grace period until July 25, 2025 to pay and keep your life coverage active.

deadline.quote: on or before the expiry of the grace period on 2025-07-25

actions.why_it_matters: Maintain life insurance cover and prevent policy lapse

documents_needed: Policy renewal notice copy or policy number
Account payee cheque (if paying offline at branch)
if_ignored: Policy will lapse, life cover protection ceases, and revival will require late fees plus health certificate.
